basic_profile.bio: I'm a strategy game enthusiast based in Madrid, Spain. I have a deep interest in geopolitics and history, which is why I love playing games like Europa Universalis IV. When I'm not strategizing my next virtual conquest, I work as a freelance graphic designer. I'm in a long-term relationship and we often enjoy traveling together. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings, especially after 9 PM, as that's when I have some downtime. I enjoy discussing economic theories, particularly those that challenge mainstream capitalist views.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in History from the Complutense University of Madrid, and my fascination with historical strategy games stems from my academic background. I've also self-taught myself about stock markets and economic policies, which is reflected in my frequent visits to subreddits like 'ShortStocks'. My interest in American football is relatively new, hence my activity in 'NFLNoobs'.
